name: Slays Demons in the DaTang
detailed_description:
The Great Tang Demon Slaying Technique "is a large-scale multiplayer online role-playing game with a 45 degree perspective and no locked combat mode.

The game is set in the martial arts world of the Later Tang Dynasty, featuring classic Chinese martial arts elements for in-depth interpretation. The game features a beautiful art style, three-dimensional socialization, and a focus on the gaming experience of chivalry and righteousness, closely following the social direction.

All the props required for the functions in the game do not contain probability settings, and all props are not the only way of production in the mall, which is in line with the current mature game business model.

[Character Introduction]

There are two characters that players can play in the game, namely the female gun (female character) and the male sword (male character); There is one hero character named 'Partner' who assists players in fighting in the main and side quests.

[Character Technique]

Each character has 8 skill slots (1 regular attack, 8 techniques) and can carry up to 8 techniques.

[Role Partner]

There is one companion character in the game, named 'Companion', who assists players in their battles. Players can only choose one partner at a time to assist in the battle, and the partner will help the player repel the enemy.
